about.title: About {company}
about.subtitle: Specialists in mining, exporting, and importing gold and precious stones worldwide
about.text1: {company} operates in the mining of gold and precious stones such as diamonds, emeralds, tourmalines, ruby, and aquamarine, with extensive hands-on experience in exporting and importing all these minerals around the world.
about.text2: Headquartered in Miami, United States, with offices in Dubai, Rome, Africa, and Brazil, we operate efficiently and responsibly, connecting exporters, refineries, and institutional buyers.
about.mission.text: Ensure safe, transparent, and ethical precious metals trading operations worldwide.
about.vision.text: Be an international benchmark in excellence, compliance, and innovation in the precious metals sector.

values.integrity.desc: We operate with the highest ethical standards and transparency in all our transactions.
values.responsibility.desc: We are committed to sustainable and responsible practices across the entire supply chain.
values.excellence.desc: We pursue excellence in every process, ensuring quality and safety in each operation.
values.compliance.desc: We strictly follow international standards and regulations in the precious metals industry.

services.title: Complete Solutions in Precious Metals Import and Trade
services.subtitle: We offer specialized services for every stage of the gold trading process

0.title: Hand Carry – Dubai
0.description: Secure and personalized procedures for importing gold in hand luggage. We work with Transguard Security and certified refineries.

1.title: Cargo Import
1.subtitle: (Cargo Carry)
1.description: Logistics coordination for air freight with complete documentation, inspection, and customs clearance in Dubai.

2.title: Assay and Refining
2.description: Technical analysis at partner refineries, with the issuance of an assay report before finalizing the purchase.

3.title: Compliance and Due Diligence
3.description: Complete support in validating documents and KYC (Know Your Customer) for sellers and exporters.

4.title: Consulting and Support
4.description: Support in structuring export operations, guidance on licenses, taxes, and international certifications.

5.title: Sale of Gold and Precious Stones
5.description: Trading of gold and precious stones such as diamonds, emeralds, tourmalines, rubies, and aquamarines with certification of origin and quality.

benefits.2: Competitive prices in the international market

compliance.title: Commitment to Legality, Responsibility, and Human Rights
compliance.subtitle: At {company}, compliance is non-negotiable. We operate according to the highest international standards of ethics, governance, and responsibility.
guidelines: Adherence to GIA, ICC, OECD standards and US legislation
Strict policy against money laundering and terrorism financing
Prohibition of involvement with conflict areas or human rights violations
Code of Conduct for employees and business partners
Rigorous Due Diligence processes throughout the supply chain
compliance.documents_footer: All our procedures are regularly audited by independent entities to ensure compliance with international standards.
compliance.transparency_text: We believe that transparency is fundamental to building trust. Therefore, we provide all necessary information about our processes, partnerships, and certifications.
